title: A1 Milestone 8: Review
completion_message: ¡Felicidades! Has completado el Hito 8. Ahora dominas los Modal Verbs, el First Conditional, cláusulas de tiempo para futuro, Present Continuous para planes y vocabulario de reuniones.

parts.visual: Hito 8 cubrió: Modals (Should, Must, Have to, Mustn't, Might). First Conditional (If + present + will). Time Clauses (When / As soon as + present). Present Continuous para planes futuros (I am meeting).
parts.audio: Milestone eight covered: Modal verbs like should, must, have to, mustn't, and might. First Conditional, Time Clauses, and Present Continuous for future plans.

parts.visual: También: Repaso de Comparativos (faster than) y Superlativos (the best), y Vocabulario de Reuniones (agenda, minutes, attendee, chair, postpone).
parts.audio: Also: Review of Comparatives and Superlatives, and Meetings Vocabulary like agenda, minutes, and attendee.

questions.question: If we reduce the price, sales ____ increase. (Condicional).
If she ____ the contract, we will start. (Firma).
I will call you when I ____. (Llegue).
As soon as we ____ the email, we will reply. (Recibamos).
I ____ meeting the client tomorrow. (Plan agendado).
questions.explanation: Present continuous for future: am meeting.

questions.question: She ____ flying to London next week. (Plan agendado).
Our software is ____ than theirs. (Más rápido).
Please send the ____ before the meeting. (Lista de temas).
There are ten ____ in the meeting. (Asistentes).
You ____ pay for the coffee, it's free. (No tienes que).
questions.explanation: Don't have to = no es necesario.

questions.question: Do I ____ to pay now? (¿Tengo que?).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe la respuesta correcta del Hito 8.

questions.question: If it rains, we ____ stay. (Condicional - resultado).
I will call you when I ____. (Llegue - arrive).
Our software is ____ than theirs. (Más rápido).

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la frase exacta del Hito 8.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
options: You have to arrive on time.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: You mustn't smoke in the office.
options: You mustn't smoke in the office.
You shouldn't smoke in the office.
You don't have to smoke in the office.
He mustn't smoke in the office.
questions.correct_answer: You mustn't smoke in the office.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: They might not accept the offer.
options: They might not accept the offer.
They will not accept the offer.
They must not accept the offer.
We might not accept the offer.
questions.correct_answer: They might not accept the offer.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: If we reduce the price, sales will increase.
options: If we reduce the price, sales will increase.
If they reduce the price, sales will increase.
If we reduce the price, sales might increase.
If we change the price, sales will increase.
questions.correct_answer: If we reduce the price, sales will increase.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: I will call you when I arrive.
options: I will call you when I arrive.
I will call you when she arrives.
I will call you as soon as I arrive.
He will call you when I arrive.
questions.correct_answer: I will call you when I arrive.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: I am meeting the client tomorrow.
options: I am meeting the client tomorrow.
She is meeting the client tomorrow.
I will meet the client tomorrow.
I am meeting a client tomorrow.
questions.correct_answer: I am meeting the client tomorrow.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Our software is faster than theirs.
options: Our software is faster than theirs.
Our system is faster than theirs.
Our software is better than theirs.
Our software is faster than ours.
questions.correct_answer: Our software is faster than theirs.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Please send the agenda before the meeting.
options: Please send the agenda before the meeting.
Please send the minutes before the meeting.
Please check the agenda before the meeting.
Please read the agenda before the meeting.
questions.correct_answer: Please send the agenda before the meeting.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: We need to schedule a meeting.
options: We need to schedule a meeting.
We need to cancel a meeting.
We need to postpone a meeting.
We need to attend a meeting.
questions.correct_answer: We need to schedule a meeting.
